characterDescription: Brutal Structural Bar: 80px height with 8px solid near-black bottom border — the nav is a newspaper masthead, a heavy rule that defines the top of the page. Anton all-caps at 1rem with 0.05em tracking reads as a declaration, not a menu. Fixed, always visible, never changes on scroll. Hover: instant black background fill with white text, zero transition. The nav announces the page before the content can.

_twist.description: Brutalist transformation: 80px height (newspaper masthead scale), 8px border-bottom (thick rule). Anton font all-caps — no Barlow, no gentle sans. Zero transitions (0s). Hover is instant color inversion. Check C PASS: Anton is in the assembled type system.
